description: Opt-in: when a session starts or resumes, remove worktrees and branches whose PR already merged, and list what a merge left behind; and tell the session where the branch's work stands, from IMPL.md and local git. Each is off until switched on in /config. With a [board] table in ~/.claude/techne.toml, each issue or PR a gh command opens goes on that GitHub Projects board.

hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_CLEAN_FINISHED_WORK" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/sisters/scripts/hygiene.py" --auto --hook ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_RESUME_BRIEF" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/resume_brief.py" ;; esac
